question: Which of the following pairs of human male chromosome is mismatched in size?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sex chromosomes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sex chromosomes** in human males consist of one **X chromosome** and one **Y chromosome**. These chromosomes are mismatched in size, with the X chromosome being significantly larger than the Y chromosome.
 
• The **X chromosome** contains approximately 155 million base pairs and hosts several hundred genes, while the **Y chromosome** is much smaller, with only about 58 million base pairs and fewer than 80 genes.
 
• This size difference is due to the evolutionary loss of genetic material on the Y chromosome over time, making it much smaller and gene-poor compared to the X chromosome.
 
• In contrast, autosomes are paired chromosomes that are generally similar in size and genetic content, making them matched pairs.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is "Sex chromosomes."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chromosomes:**

 
 
• Humans have **46 chromosomes**, organized into 23 pairs. These include 22 pairs of autosomes and 1 pair of sex chromosomes.
 
• **Autosomes:** These are non-sex chromosomes and are numbered from 1 to 22 based on size, with chromosome 1 being the largest.
 
• **Sex chromosomes:** In males, the sex chromosome pair is **XY**, and in females, it is **XX**. The Y chromosome determines male sex characteristics.
 
 
 
• **Functions of Sex Chromosomes:**
 
 
• The **X chromosome** plays a vital role in both sexes, as it carries genes related to essential functions such as vision, immunity, and reproduction.
 
• The **Y chromosome** carries genes like **SRY (Sex-determining Region Y)**, which is crucial for the development of male gonads (testes).
 
 
 
• **Autosomal Chromosomes:**
 
 
• These chromosomes contain genes responsible for most of the body's structures and functions, such as metabolic processes, growth, and immunity.
 
• Autosomal pairs are homologous, meaning both chromosomes in a pair are similar in size and gene content.
 
 
 
• **Comparison of Chromosome Pairs:**
 
 
• The **first pair of autosomes** is the largest, while the **twentieth pair** and other smaller autosomal pairs are similar in size.
 
• Unlike autosomes, sex chromosomes differ significantly, with the Y chromosome being much smaller than the X chromosome.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Genetic Disorders Related to Sex Chromosomes:**

 
 
• **Turner Syndrome:** Occurs in females who have only one X chromosome (45, X0).
 
• **Klinefelter Syndrome:** A condition in males with an extra X chromosome (47, XXY).
 
• **Y-linked disorders:** Rare disorders caused by mutations in genes present on the Y chromosome.
 
 
 
• **Chromosomal Studies:**
 
 
• Chromosome analysis is essential for diagnosing genetic conditions and understanding evolutionary biology.
 
• Techniques like **karyotyping** and **fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH)** are used for studying chromosomes.
